artifacts.summary: Confirms Part 1 (defect-class registration sites, recommends AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH) and Part 2 (TASK_DIR binding fix, recommends option-b threaded parameter) with a corrected finding on the doc's missing literal 'thirteen'.

memory_candidates.content: In agent-system/extensions/core/context/patterns/system-defect-discrimination.md, the Signal A instance count is never spelled out as a literal word in the document's own prose (no 'thirteen' anywhere) -- only system-defect-record.sh's comment/error-message use that literal. The doc instead narrates its class-count growth across separate paragraphs ('ten pre-existing instances', 'a further three instances'). When registering a new defect class, add a new short paragraph following that existing two-paragraph narration pattern rather than searching for a count word to edit in place.

skill_postflight_update (scripts/skill-base.sh) already has an optional 5th positional parameter (phase_check_mode, default empty string). Adding a further optional 6th positional parameter (e.g. task_dir_override, defaulting to ${TASK_DIR:-}) is a safe, additive way to remove an ambient-env-var dependency from a shared lifecycle function without disturbing any existing 4-arg or 5-arg caller -- a reusable pattern for de-coupling other guards in this file from ambient TASK_DIR/TASK_TYPE globals that only skill-context callers currently populate.
